snippet.title: The LEGO Movie Videogame Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into a LEGO® game unlike any other and become a true Master Builder!  The LEGO Movie Videogame is now available! 

Play it today on Xbox One, Xbox 360, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Vita, Wii U, Nintendo 3DS, and Windows PC.

Own it today: http://bit.ly/1iVJBrs
